title: Mech Redesign
summary: A hard-surface mech redesign where I focused on getting the joint logic right and making the topology clean. Full breakdown from concept to final with wireframes.

title: Mech Recon Unit
summary: A lightweight 4-legged recon mech for the Delta-Forge lineup. Kept the poly-count low on purpose, used ND-Tools, and went with a deep-space colour palette.

title: Sci-Fi Pipe System
summary: A topology exercise where I built an interconnected sci-fi pipe system. This is where I learned bevel masks and material layering, which I use in basically every project now.

title: Train Station
summary: A big environment scene I built from a Pinterest reference. Lots of architectural modelling at scale, material layering practice, and a quick MiniBot prop I made in under 2 hours.

title: Procedural Planet
summary: A fully procedural planet made entirely with noise textures and volume shaders. No image textures at all, just Blender nodes for the surface, clouds, and atmosphere.
